name: AWEFonts World Language Registry

source.name: Glottolog
source.citation: Hammarström, Harald, Robert Forkel, Martin Haspelmath and Sebastian Bank. 2026. Glottolog 5.4. Leipzig: Max Planck Institute for Evolutionary Anthropology.

countingPolicy: Only Glottolog level=language records are included. Dialects, families, and other languoids are excluded.
coveragePolicy: fontFamilyIds are only actual cmap matches from the pinned Google Fonts binary corpus. Results are profile-level; sample-text-only results do not prove full orthography. Multi-script language records retain per-profile results. No shaping or rendering claim is made.
